name: apepatrol
description: Firefox investigation companion for MaxPatrol SIEM

scripts.build:firefox: npm run lint && npm test && node scripts/build.mjs && npm run verify:policy && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.build:self-hosted: npm run lint && npm test && node scripts/build.mjs --self-hosted && npm run verify:policy && node scripts/lint-firefox.mjs --self-hosted
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename apepatrol-{version}-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
